title: 很多人邀约不出来核心原因，框架太弱

timeline.summary: The video opens on a private chat and Mikey reads his proposed time and location.
The other participant says she will see whether she has time; the green side challenges the apparent reversal and she says the tone feels casual or unserious.
Mikey narrates a confrontational reply sequence that belittles the concern and asserts that meeting must come first; the visible chat broadly matches the order.
He tells viewers to memorize and deploy the full sequence regardless of the reply.
He highlights withholding a response as a tactic; the other participant eventually says “好/谢谢” and the edit ends.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He presents a private-message sequence in which his side challenges a woman who changes a definite plan into “I’ll see if I have time.”
claims.conditions: The screenshot confirms message order only; it does not establish motives, relationship context or a successful meeting.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He tells viewers to memorize a fixed confrontational sequence and send it regardless of the recipient’s reply.
claims.conditions: This suppresses context and the other person’s autonomy; it must not be operationalized as advice.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He describes not replying as a deliberate tactic and treats the later “好/谢谢” as part of the demonstration.
claims.conditions: Silence may have many meanings; the screenshot does not prove persuasion, consent or a later meeting.

speaker_attribution.speaker: Mikey / right-green chat side
speaker_attribution.basis: Narration repeatedly says “I said” while the corresponding right-green messages are highlighted; this supports editorial attribution but does not independently authenticate the account.

speaker_attribution.speaker: other private-chat participant / left-gray side
speaker_attribution.basis: Left-gray messages are read as the woman’s replies; identity is redacted and remains unverified.

visual_findings: All content-bearing frames are a scrolling private WeChat chat; no live speaker or meeting outcome is shown.
The display masks the contact name and avatar area, but exact date/time and a distinctive conversation remain visible and potentially identifying.
The 61 one-second dense frames confirm the order: scheduling proposal, changed availability, objections, green-side insults/pressure, green-side silence, then a short “好/谢谢” reply.

permissions.reason: Private-chat material with uncertain authorization and an adversarial scripted tactic that disregards the other person’s reply.

limitations: The screenshot may be edited or incomplete and does not authenticate either participant.
No evidence shows that a meeting occurred or that the tactic caused the final reply.
Private correspondence remains sensitive despite partial redaction.
